paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Zemina, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Kilayim, chapter 4; Chomer BaKodesh, halakhah 2. But Tosafot on Chagigah 23b, has bar Chanina. Rabbi Abba bar Zemina was perhaps his brother.
